changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE team_repository_credentials ( team_repository_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES team_repositories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, access_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deploy_key' CHECK (access_type IN ('deploy_key', 'github_app')), encrypted_private_key TEXT, public_key_fingerprint TEXT, github_app_installation_id BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ );

changeSet.author: wasnertobias
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_sessions ADD COLUMN repo_url TEXT, ADD COLUMN repo_slug TEXT, ADD COLUMN team_repository_id INTEGER REFERENCES team_repositories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_agent_sessions_team_repository ON agent_sessions(team_repository_id);
